messages:
Noah Rivera: Quick flag after poking at today's playground build: opening a function "def card" expands an inline schema preview that shifts the run history. Hard to compare previous invocations when things jump. Anyone else notice?

Priya Singh: Yep saw that. The animation is smooth but the page reflow loses vertical context. I think a microcard (single-line summary) could sit inline and expand into an overlay rather than pushing content.

Jordan Lee: Overlay could work but overlays break copy/paste and some keyboard workflows. Alternative: collapse-to-row with a chevron and a small type + icon summary (e.g., "upload:file", "text:prompt"). Row stays fixed height so history doesn't move.

Clara Park: Copy note: we use a handful of verbs across console. Current labels: "Run", "Execute", "Invoke" are all present. Can we pick one? My preference is "Run" for parity with pipelines.

Noah Rivera: Agreed on consistency. Also accessibility: when the schema expands, screen reader reads "expanded" but not which function. We should set aria-live or an aria-label like `aria-label="Schema preview for function CreateSummary (expanded)"`.

UIHelperBot: Created issue #501: "Schema preview screen-reader context and focus order". Suggested acceptance criteria: 1) expanded control has verbose aria-label 2) focus moves to first editable field 3) announcement uses polite aria-live region.

Priya Singh: Small visual: param-type chips in run history would speed scanning. Instead of text-only args like `title: 'q'`, show a tiny chip with icon + short label (e.g., [TXT], [IMG]). Keep chips 14px tall, single-line, high contrast.

Jordan Lee: Implementation note: chips should be semantic elements with role="listitem" and an `aria-label` describing the param (e.g., "title: text"). That keeps them readable by assistive tech. Also make them keyboard-focusable when the user tabs through a run entry.

Clara Park: UX poll: collapse-preview-by-default for power users, expanded-for-newbies. We could store a flag in localStorage or in the user profile. Which storage do people prefer?

Noah Rivera: LocalStorage for quick iteration, but add an account-level override later. For prototypes let's do localStorage with a lightweight toggle in the header: "Preview: Auto / Collapsed / Expanded".

Priya Singh: Tiny copy nit: rename "Schema (inferred)" to "Schema preview — inferred" (em dash) so it reads as an adjective. Also add a micro-copy below when inference fails: "Schema couldn't be inferred. Edit manually."

Jordan Lee: Runtime concern: if we collapse results we must not drop ephemeral KV cache entries required for replay. I'll sync with runtime team to confirm lifetime semantics; filing a runtime ticket now.

UIHelperBot: Linked issue #502 for KV cache retention on collapsed results. Assigned to @Jordan Lee.

Priya Singh: Keyboard shortcuts: we have `R` for run in some screens but not in the playground. Suggest binding `R` universally and making it visible in a tooltip on hover of the Run button and in the help overlay.

Noah Rivera: Ops: when the microcard expands inline, focus should stay where the user was in the run history (do not jump). If the user explicitly expands for edit, move focus into the schema editor. We need two behaviors: preview-expand vs edit-expand.

Clara Park: I can prototype both states in the spec mock. Will add a small animation for the preview (fade+scale) and a hard transition for edit mode so SR users get predictable focus change.

Jordan Lee: Quick dev checklist I will follow: 1) param chips accessible elements 2) focus-order change when entering edit mode 3) validate KV retention 4) wire up aria-live announcement.

Priya Singh: I'll push a small copy PR after Clara's mock lands. Also will update the global copy tokens for the Run label.

Noah Rivera: Small poll in thread: prefer "Run" or "Execute"? Reply with :one: for Run, :two: for Execute.

Clara Park: :one: (Run)

Priya Singh: :one: (Run)

Jordan Lee: :one:

UIHelperBot: Recorded poll result: 3 votes for "Run". Poll closed.

Noah Rivera: Great. I'll open an interaction spec PR that includes: microcard row design, chip tokens, aria-label patterns, focus rules, and localStorage toggle. Will link prototype. Please review when I drop it.

Clara Park: Thanks — adding the design task to the weekly agenda. :spiral_calendar: 

Priya Singh: Done. Quick TODO summary for thread: [Noah] spec PR + prototype, [Clara] detailed mock & animations, [Jordan] runtime KV ticket + accessibility fixes, [Priya] copy PR and tooltip updates.

UIHelperBot: Noted TODOs on project board and linked this thread.
